summary: Braskem S.A. filed a 6-K disclosing that SHINE I FIP acquired a 34.3234% total capital stake (50.1108% voting) from NSP Inv. in a private block trade. No price per share, premium, or total value are stated. The board has not issued a recommendation; no financial advisor is named. The transaction closed on June 3, 2026, with a new shareholders' agreement effective immediately. NSP Inv. retains a 4% preferred stake with no governance rights. The acquirer disclaims intent to delist within one year. Watch for any regulatory filings or further ownership disclosures.
